import Foundation

/// A file snapshot used only by native multipart bodies, independently of JSON models.
public struct KajiMultipartFile: Sendable {
    public let data: Data
    public let filename: String
    public let contentType: String
    public let headers: [String: String]
    public init(data: Data, filename: String = "blob", contentType: String = "application/octet-stream", headers: [String: String] = [:]) {
        self.data = Data(data); self.filename = filename
        self.contentType = contentType; self.headers = headers
    }
}

public enum KajiMultipartError: Error, Sendable {
    case invalidLimit, bodyTooLarge, tooManyParts, invalidFilename, invalidContentType, invalidHeader
    case missingHeader(String), unknownPart, boundaryCollision
}
internal struct KajiEncodedMultipart: Sendable { let body: Data; let contentType: String }
internal struct KajiMultipartPart: Sendable {
    let name: String; let body: Data; let filename: String?; let contentType: String; let headers: [String: String]
}
internal struct KajiMultipartEncoder {
    let maximumBodyBytes: Int
    private var parts: [KajiMultipartPart] = []
    private var payloadBytes = 0
    init(maximumBodyBytes: Int) throws {
        guard maximumBodyBytes > 0 && maximumBodyBytes <= 268_435_456 else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidLimit }
        self.maximumBodyBytes = maximumBodyBytes
    }

    static func token(_ value: String) -> Bool {
        !value.isEmpty && value.utf8.allSatisfy { byte in
            (48...57).contains(byte) || (65...90).contains(byte) || (97...122).contains(byte) || Array("!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~".utf8).contains(byte)
        }
    }
    static func mediaType(_ value: String) -> Bool {
        let pieces = value.split(separator: "/", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
        return pieces.count == 2 && pieces.allSatisfy { token(String($0)) && !$0.contains("*") }
    }
    static func headers(_ values: [String: String], required: [String]) throws -> [String: String] {
        var names: Set<String> = []
        for (name, value) in values {
            let lower = name.lowercased()
            guard token(name), !["content-type", "content-disposition", "content-length"].contains(lower), names.insert(lower).inserted,
                  value.utf8.allSatisfy({ $0 == 9 || (32...126).contains($0) }) else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidHeader }
        }
        for name in required where !names.contains(name.lowercased()) { throw KajiMultipartError.missingHeader(name) }
        return values
    }
    static func scalarString<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> String {
        if let string = value as? String { return string }
        let bytes = try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        if bytes.first == 34 { return try JSONDecoder().decode(String.self, from: bytes) }
        guard let string = String(data: bytes, encoding: .utf8) else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidHeader }
        return string
    }
    mutating func scalar<T: Encodable>(name: String, value: T, contentType: String, headers: [String: String]) throws {
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        let string = try Self.scalarString(value)
        guard string.utf8.count <= maximumBodyBytes else { throw KajiMultipartError.bodyTooLarge }
        try add(name: name, body: Data(string.utf8), filename: nil, contentType: contentType, headers: headers)
    }
    mutating func json<T: Encodable>(name: String, value: T, contentType: String, headers: [String: String]) throws {
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        let bytes = try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        try add(name: name, body: bytes, filename: nil, contentType: contentType, headers: headers)
    }
    mutating func file(name: String, value: KajiMultipartFile, contentType: String?, headers: [String: String], requiredHeaders: [String] = []) throws {
        guard !value.filename.isEmpty && value.filename.utf8.allSatisfy({ (32...126).contains($0) && $0 != 34 && $0 != 92 }) else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidFilename }
        var merged = headers
        for (name, value) in value.headers {
            guard !merged.keys.contains(where: { $0.caseInsensitiveCompare(name) == .orderedSame }) else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidHeader }
            merged[name] = value
        }
        merged = try Self.headers(merged, required: requiredHeaders)
        try add(name: name, body: value.data, filename: value.filename, contentType: contentType ?? value.contentType, headers: merged)
    }
    private mutating func add(name: String, body: Data, filename: String?, contentType: String, headers: [String: String]) throws {
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        guard maximumBodyBytes > 0 && maximumBodyBytes <= 268_435_456 else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidLimit }
        guard parts.count < 1024 else { throw KajiMultipartError.tooManyParts }
        guard body.count <= maximumBodyBytes - payloadBytes else { throw KajiMultipartError.bodyTooLarge }
        guard Self.mediaType(contentType) else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidContentType }
        payloadBytes += body.count
        parts.append(KajiMultipartPart(name: name, body: body, filename: filename, contentType: contentType, headers: try Self.headers(headers, required: [])))
    }
    func finish() throws -> KajiEncodedMultipart {
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        guard maximumBodyBytes > 0 && maximumBodyBytes <= 268_435_456 else { throw KajiMultipartError.invalidLimit }
        var boundary = ""
        for _ in 0..<4 {
            try Task.checkCancellation()
            let candidate = "kaji-" + UUID().uuidString.lowercased()
            let marker = Data(("--" + candidate).utf8)
            if !parts.contains(where: { $0.body.range(of: marker) != nil }) { boundary = candidate; break }
        }
        guard !boundary.isEmpty else { throw KajiMultipartError.boundaryCollision }
        var body = Data()
        func append(_ bytes: Data) throws {
            guard bytes.count <= maximumBodyBytes - body.count else { throw KajiMultipartError.bodyTooLarge }
            body.append(bytes)
        }
        for part in parts {
            try Task.checkCancellation()
            var head = "--\(boundary)\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"\(part.name)\""
            if let filename = part.filename { head += "; filename=\"\(filename)\"" }
            head += "\r\nContent-Type: \(part.contentType)\r\n"
            for name in part.headers.keys.sorted() { head += "\(name): \(part.headers[name]!)\r\n" }
            head += "\r\n"
            try append(Data(head.utf8)); try append(part.body); try append(Data("\r\n".utf8))
        }
        try append(Data("--\(boundary)--\r\n".utf8))
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        return KajiEncodedMultipart(body: body, contentType: "multipart/form-data; boundary=\(boundary)")
    }
